prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: opaque settlement-panel header illustration for an original dark-fantasy mercenary game; one separate image, 1536x640 pixels, very wide 12:5 landscape composition.
Input images: Image 1 (site-city.png) and Image 2 (site-mill.png) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: weathered timber and stone, broad-brush black ink contours and hatching, muted earthy wash, rugged hand-drawn materials. Do not reproduce their isolated map-icon composition or transparent backgrounds.
Primary request: a small mercenary field camp at night. A modest campfire glows among empty laid-out and rolled bedrolls; a tattered plain dark-red banner hangs from a wooden pole, with two worn wooden carts nearby. A few practical low canvas shelters frame this small temporary camp. Late-autumn muddy ground, sparse fallen leaves and bare trees. The banner is cloth only, with no emblem or writing; all bedrolls are empty.
Composition/framing: wide three-quarter elevated view across the camp; campfire, empty bedrolls, dark-red banner on its pole and carts all plainly readable in the central wide horizontal band. Full-bleed continuous night landscape and sky, no border, no isolated diorama.
Lighting/mood: overcast late-autumn night, no visible moon or stars; restrained warm campfire light against cold charcoal and slate-gray clouded surroundings. Somber original dark fantasy grounded in practical rural medieval materials; sufficient firelit detail for a readable short UI header, unmistakably nighttime.
Style/medium: broad expressive black ink brush lines, irregular hand-hatched shadows, muted earthy watercolor wash; weathered brown, muted rust-red banner, charcoal, slate-gray and subdued amber firelight. Match both references' hand-worked material character, not glossy photorealism or 3D rendering.
Constraints: fully opaque image edge to edge. No people in the foreground, preferably no people anywhere, no sleeping figures or human silhouettes. No text, letters, numbers, runes, logos, symbols, signatures or watermarks. Original setting; do not imitate any existing game or artist.
model: image_gen (built-in; underlying model identifier not exposed)
